def choose_move(observation):
    # Defensive defaults
    # Try to extract generic signals safely
    t = observation.get("type", None)

    # Common fields across games
    pos = observation.get("position", {})
    x = pos.get("x", 0)
    y = pos.get("y", 0)
    enemy = observation.get("enemies", [])
    resources = observation.get("resources", [])
    territory = observation.get("territory", 0)

    # Basic safe movement: prioritize minimizing distance to nearest resource or opponent depending on type
    dx = 0
    dy = 0

    # Resource collection: move toward nearest resource if any
    if t == "resource_collection":
        if resources:
            # find nearest resource
            best = None
            bestd = 9999
            for r in resources:
                rx = r.get("x", 0)
                ry = r.get("y", 0)
                d = abs(rx - x) + abs(ry - y)
                if d < bestd:
                    bestd = d
                    best = (rx, ry)
            if best is not None:
                rx, ry = best
                dx = 1 if rx > x else -1 if rx < x else 0
                dy = 1 if ry > y else -1 if ry < y else 0
                return [dx, dy]

    # Pursuit/Evasion: if there are enemies, try to keep away from closest
    if t == "pursuit_evasion":
        if enemy:
            best = None
            bestd = 9999
            for e in enemy:
                ex = e.get("x", 0)
                ey = e.get("y", 0)
                d = abs(ex - x) + abs(ey - y)
                if d < bestd:
                    bestd = d
                    best = (ex, ey)
            if best is not None:
                ex, ey = best
                # move away: choose dx, dy to increase distance
                dx = -1 if ex > x else 1 if ex < x else 0
                dy = -1 if ey > y else 1 if ey < y else 0
                # clamp to allowed
                if dx not in (-1, 0, 1): dx = 0
                if dy not in (-1, 0, 1): dy = 0
                return [dx, dy]

    # Territory control: move toward nearest frontier/objective
    if t == "territory_control":
        # attempt to move toward high value territory score if provided
        if isinstance(territory, dict):
            tx = territory.get("x", None)
            ty = territory.get("y", None)
            if tx is not None and ty is not None:
                dx = 1 if tx > x else -1 if tx < x else 0
                dy = 1 if ty > y else -1 if ty < y else 0
                return [dx, dy]

        # fallback: move toward center (0,0) or origin
        dx = -1 if 0 > x else 1 if 0 < x else 0
        dy = -1 if 0 > y else 1 if 0 < y else 0
        return [dx, dy]

    # Fallback: simple explore toward a default safe direction (toward origin)
    dx = -1 if 0 > x else 1 if 0 < x else 0
    dy = -1 if 0 > y else 1 if 0 < y else 0
    return [dx, dy]
